subject: Acceptance test inventory, exit gates & cutover accountabilities - Acme Health eval
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Chen <mike.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-22 09:12 -0700
Subject: Acceptance test inventory, exit gates & cutover accountabilities - Acme Health eval

Hi Mike —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As we discussed, the next step is a short, unambiguous acceptance checklist we can use to sign off the eval and move to a beta cutover. I drafted a compact inventory below and a proposed two-week cutover window. Can you confirm stakeholders and any legal/procurement constraints?

High-level acceptance inventory (draft):
- Functional baseline: 98% intent-to-action mapping on our representative prompt set (see telemetry buckets).
- Latency SLA: 95th percentile response < 350ms for 512-token workflows under your pilot traffic profile.
- Error rate: < 1% downstream failures (timeouts, kernel errors) across 5000 requests/day sample.
- Data handling: KV cache eviction and redaction proof for PHI-adjacent fields; audited by your security team.
- Model reproducibility: deterministic seed runs for smoke prompts (3 runs).

Exit gates:
1) Evidence folder populated with telemetry export + sample transcripts and tagging.
2) Security/compliance checklist signed by Acme InfoSec (items 1-6 in the questionnaire).
3) Billing & procurement pre-approval for dedicated capacity or formal usage cap.

Proposed immediate asks from Acme:
- Confirm who signs security/compliance (name + email).
- Confirm if procurement needs an MSA addendum for pilot credits.
- Any additional acceptance tests you want added (e.g., hallucination tolerance threshold).

I attached a telemetry matrix and a simple MAP template (MAP-v1) that maps owners to each gate. Jonas will coordinate verification runs; Ben will pick up billing/procurement threads if needed.

If this looks good, can we lock in an evidence handoff date of 2027-06-04 and a cutover readiness check on 2027-06-08?

Thanks —
Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: acme-eval-telemetry-matrix.xlsx, MAP-v1-Acme-Redwood.pdf
From: Mike Chen <mike.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@acmehealth.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-22 11:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance test inventory, exit gates & cutover accountabilities - Acme Health eval

Stephanie —

Appreciate the clear draft. Quick answers:
- Security sign-off will come from Alyssa Grant (InfoSec lead) — cc'd. She will need the redaction proof and a short runbook for how data is retained during the run.
- Procurement: we're OK to proceed under the pilot SOW but will need estimated spend vs credits documented by next Tuesday. Procurement is on copy (procurement@acmehealth.com).
- Additional acceptance test: please include a simple hallucination spot-check (20 prompts with ground truth) and a tolerance threshold we can debate.

Evidence handoff 2027-06-04 works for us. Cutover check 2027-06-08 also fine, assuming the telemetry export is complete and Alyssa has had 48 hours to review.

I'll push Alyssa to fill in the security checklist by Friday.

Best,
Mike
Mike Chen
Director, Data Products — Acme Health
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-23 08:46 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance test inventory, exit gates & cutover accountabilities - Acme Health eval

Looping in Monica for the verification run ownership and to confirm billing cadence. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Telemetry matrix: the attached sheet specifies the exact event keys we'll export (request_id, prompt_hash, model_variant, latency_ms, error_code, label_tag). Please verify your sample IDs so we can mask PHI fields pre-export.
2) Hallucination check: propose the following protocol — 20 prompts, two annotators from Acme label correctness, pass if >= 90% agreement and <= 10% significant hallucinations. If fail, we run targeted prompt engineering + one retest.
3) Cutover accountabilities:
   - Evidence handoff (2027-06-04): Stephanie (owner), Jonas (verification engineer), Alyssa (InfoSec reviewer).
   - Billing approval (by 2027-06-01): Ben (owner) to confirm estimated spend vs credits; procurement to respond with PO or written approval.
   - Go/no-go call (2027-06-08 11:00 PT): attendees — Acme execs, Alyssa, Stephanie, Jonas, Ben.

Attachments: acme-eval-telemetry-matrix.xlsx (v2), MAP-v1-Acme-Redwood.pdf

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Chen <mike.chen@acmehealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-24 15:08 -07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance test inventory, exit gates & cutover accountabilities - Acme Health eval

Thanks everyone — quick operational notes and confirmation so we have a single source of truth.

Operational checklist (finalized):
- Telemetry export: Jonas will run export job on 2027-06-01; export will be delivered as CSV and S3 link to Acme.
- PHI redaction: use field-mask v1 in the telemetry matrix; Jonas to attach redaction log.
- Hallucination spot-check: Acme provides labels by 2027-06-02; Redwood runs analytics and returns pass/fail by EOD 2027-06-03.
- Security evidence: Alyssa to confirm checklist items 1-6 by 2027-05-28.
- Procurement: Ben will send a one-page spend vs credits summary by 2027-05-27.

Decision cadence:
- If hallucination spot-check fails OR security checklist incomplete by the handoff date, we move the go/no-go call to 2027-06-10. Otherwise we keep 2027-06-08 11:00 PT.

Please reply only if any of the named owners above need to change. I'll create a shared folder and populate the MAP template after procurement note arrives.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwoodinference.com
Attachments referenced: MAP-v1-Acme-Redwood.pdf
